data.name: Bags
data.description: Launch a coin on BagsApp and earn royalties.

methodology.Fees: On Solana: total trading fees paid by users when swapping against Bags DBC pools (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 pools (post-migration), excluding the underlying Meteora protocol fee, DAMMv2 LP fees and any referral fees. On Robinhood Chain: token creation fees plus gross trading fees charged on Bags bonding-curve swaps (pre-migration) and Uniswap v4 hook swaps (post-migration) across the V1 and V2 deployments.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator fees paid to token creators, plus (on Robinhood Chain V2) the partner/referrer share carved out of the protocol half of trading fees.
methodology.Revenue: Bags' net share: on Solana, trading-fee revenue from DBC (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 (post-migration); on Robinhood Chain, token creation fees plus the protocol share of trading fees (50% of gross, minus the partner cut on V2 pools with a partner).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Net revenue earned by the Bags protocol from trading and token-creation activity.

Fees.Creator Fees: Creator fees to token creators from Bags DBC pools (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 pools (post-migration) on Solana.
Fees.Protocol Fees: Protocol fees to Bags protocol from Bags DBC pools (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 pools (post-migration) on Solana.
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Gross trading fees charged on Robinhood Chain bonding-curve swaps and post-migration Uniswap v4 hook swaps.
Fees.Token Creation Fees: Token creation fees paid to the Bags vault on each Robinhood Chain token launch.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Creator share of trading fees: Bags DBC/DAMMv2 pools on Solana, and 50% of bonding-curve and hook trading fees on Robinhood Chain (on V1 the partner/referrer cut is carved out of this share downstream).
SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees: Partner/referrer share on Robinhood Chain V2: partnerFeeBps (default 25%) of the protocol half of trading fees.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: Protocol share of trading fees kept by Bags: DBC/DAMMv2 fees on Solana, and the protocol half of Robinhood Chain trading fees net of the V2 partner cut.
Revenue.Token Creation Fees: Token creation fees paid to the Bags vault on each Robinhood Chain token launch.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Protocol share of trading fees kept by Bags: DBC/DAMMv2 fees on Solana, and the protocol half of Robinhood Chain trading fees net of the V2 partner cut.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Creation Fees: Token creation fees paid to the Bags vault on each Robinhood Chain token launch.
